scope: Single frozen public passage, not full repository

claims.name: 1.0 Site Context December 2016
claims.description: The Site Context section (page 47) is dated December 2016.

claims.name: The Lakes
claims.description: The Baton Rouge Lakes are the subject of the site context; they are primarily owned by Louisiana State University, with City Park Lake and Lake Erie as exceptions.

claims.name: The Lakes are primarily owned by Louisiana State University
claims.description: Primary ownership of The Lakes rests with Louisiana State University.

claims.name: City Park Lake and Lake Erie, which is owned by the City-Parish of Baton Rouge
claims.description: Exception to LSU ownership: City Park Lake and Lake Erie are owned by the City-Parish of Baton Rouge.
claims.entity: City Park Lake and Lake Erie

claims.name: Park spaces within the study area are managed by The Recreation and Park Commission for the Parish of East Baton Rouge (BREC)
claims.description: Management (not ownership) of park spaces within the study area is handled by BREC, the Recreation and Park Commission for the Parish of East Baton Rouge.
claims.entity: Park spaces within the study area
claims.target: The Recreation and Park Commission for the Parish of East Baton Rouge (BREC)

claims.name: strong sense of implied ownership of the Lakes
claims.description: Residents of the neighborhoods lining the study area have a strong sense of implied ownership of the Lakes due to their immediate proximity; this is a perceived sense of ownership, not legal title.
claims.entity: residents of the neighborhoods that line the study area

claims.name: many res-idents have co-opted the lake edges into “private” gar-dens, reserves, and boat launches
claims.description: Many residents have co-opted lake edges into “private” gardens, reserves, and boat launches. These additions can add charm, beauty, and cultural integrity, but can also create issues for lake operations and maintenance as well as for adjacent property owners.

claims.name: The master planning process made every effort to ensure that residents along the Lakes were engaged
claims.description: The master planning process made every effort to engage residents along the Lakes and to preserve their sense of ownership in the Master Plan.

claims.name: LSU Owned Lake
claims.description: Legend category shown under “Lake Ownership” on the map, denoting lakes owned by LSU.
